You guys gave me SO many mixed opinions about the Pink Lemonade 7UP 😂🩷 Some of you LOVE it, others said it’s horrible… so obviously I had to try it with you!

My verdict? Why does it remind me of blue Gatorade?! 😂 I’m not a huge fan of soft drinks anyway, so I still have mixed feelings about this one.

It’s not bad… but I don’t think it’s something I’d buy again. 😅

Have you tried it? What’s your verdict? 👀

#7UPPinkLemonade #PinkLemonade #TasteTest #TryingItForTheFirstTime #Malta

#360 - Last summer, V7 Pink Lemonade took over everyone’s feed. This summer, V7 is back with another summer-edition flavor that’s already sparking curiosity.

Inspired by the nostalgic taste so many grew up with, the new V7 Cream Soda brings a favorite into their V7 range following the reveal of their refreshed identity. Its the kind of flavor that instantly feels familiar while giving Gen Z a new reason to join the conversation.

Looks like this could be the next drink you’ll be seeing all over your feed this summer.
